title: Orchestrator demotion — main thread + skills, remove the orchestrator subagent
description:
The orchestrator role currently exists twice: the main thread acts as Orchestrator (per CLAUDE.md), AND a separate `orchestrator.md` subagent ships in `.claude/agents/` + plugin-root `agents/`. The duplicate is confusing, drifts (it already needed a v1→v2 reconcile in TASK-025), and was never meant to be spawned.

**Human-decided shape:** the orchestrator IS the main thread (Fable 5) equipped with skills — not a separate agent.

Fold the orchestrator agent's operational content (workflow loop, delegation rules, ticket-update protocol, RESUME FIRST contract) into the skill layer: extend the existing `orchestrator-routing` backstop skill or restructure it into a fuller orchestrator skill. Nothing the agent file carried may be lost — diff its content against CLAUDE.md + the skill and migrate anything not already covered.

Blast radius: agents-parity.spec.js, orchestrator-agent-v2.spec.js, plugin-scaffold.spec.js inventory assertions, agent-generator's base-agent list (it patches orchestrator.md's Inputs section), and any docs referencing the orchestrator agent. `claude plugin validate` must stay green.
acceptance_criteria: orchestrator.md removed from both .claude/agents/ and plugin-root agents/; no orphaned references remain (grep for orchestrator.md across repo, docs, tests, src/agent-generator.js)

All operational content unique to the agent file is migrated into the orchestrator skill layer (orchestrator-routing or successor), mirrored byte-identical between .claude/skills/ and plugin-root skills/ per the existing parity pattern
CLAUDE.md states the orchestrator is the main thread with skills; no instruction anywhere implies spawning an orchestrator subagent

Affected tests updated to the new surface (agents-parity, orchestrator-agent-v2, plugin-scaffold, agent-generator specs) with coverage preserved, not deleted — the skill content gets the regression locks the agent file had
claude plugin validate . passes; full suite green via npm run test:all

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: SCOPE ADDITION from the TASK-031 review (rolled here as next-natural-home — this ticket already touches both spec files): (1) [was MEDIUM-1] Tighten tests/agent-models.spec.js AC4 doc assertions: scope the regexes to the '## Per-Agent Model Assignment' CLAUDE.md section slice instead of whole-document word-presence (the bare /model/i assertion was already green pre-impl), and add an assertion encoding the per-project override clause (e.g. /override|edit the `model:`/i within that section). (2) [was LOW-2] When orchestrator.md is removed, update tests/agent-models.spec.js (orchestrator_md_has_no_model_key will ENOENT) and tests/agents-parity.spec.js (hardcoded four-file list at ~line 30) — coverage must move to the new surface, not be deleted. (3) [was LOW-1, informational] CLAUDE.md:90's inherit-semantics sentence becomes fully accurate once the agent file is gone; no separate action.

comments.body: TIER ASSIGNMENT: verification_tier = tests-after — the work is content migration + deletion where the verification artifacts are SUPERSEDED existing specs (coverage moves, not new behavior); failing-tests-first would assert only absences. GATE: full npm run test:all — closing this ticket completes the refinement epic, a milestone point under the scaled-gate policy. SCOPE CONSOLIDATION (this ticket carries rolled-in items from two reviews): from TASK-031 — (a) agent-models.spec.js orchestrator_md_has_no_model_key will ENOENT on removal (replace with an assertion that the FILE is absent, preserving the no-dangling-assignment intent), (b) agents-parity.spec.js hardcoded four-file list → three, (c) tighten agent-models.spec.js AC4 doc assertions: section-scope the regexes to '## Per-Agent Model Assignment' and encode the per-project override clause. From TASK-028-via-033: the orchestrator.md step-5/step-4 duplication NIT dies with the file. ADDITIONAL BLAST RADIUS map: orchestrator-agent-v2.spec.js (pins orchestrator.md v2 session-model content — its coverage must MOVE to the skill file), plugin-scaffold.spec.js agents inventory, src/agent-generator.js base-agent list (drops orchestrator.md from the project-context patching set — SRC change), agent-models-config.spec.js/applyAgentModels (already excludes orchestrator — verify no reference), CLAUDE.md line 3 ('subagents defined in .claude/agents/' — orchestrator is the main thread), docs.spec.js, README. MIGRATION RULE (AC2): diff orchestrator.md against CLAUDE.md + orchestrator-routing SKILL.md first; anything unique (delegation protocol details, two-phase developer spawn mechanics, reviewer-isolation rule, ticket-update steps, UAT wiring, tier rubric operationalization) moves into the skill, byte-identical in both skill copies, BEFORE the file is deleted. Nothing the agent file carried may be lost.

comments.body: CLOSED — final verdict APPROVE after a REQUEST-CHANGES loop (1 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM). Commits: 2976d8a (demotion: migrate + delete + spec supersessions), fe19c45 (review fixes: lost project-context bullet migrated with non-vacuous lock; stale four-agent install script → three). Suite 488 passed / 4 skipped reproduced twice from clean; claude plugin validate PASS; dist reproducibility orchestrator-attested (rebuild → empty git status). THE ORCHESTRATOR IS NOW MAIN-THREAD + SKILLS: orchestrator.md deleted from both agent dirs, its 15 operational items (the dev's 14 + the reviewer-recovered project-context bullet) live in the orchestrator-routing skill (byte-identical copies, locked by tests/orchestrator-skill-v2.spec.js), the plugin ships exactly 3 specialist agents, and every doc frames the orchestrator as the session itself. Coverage moved and in two places strengthened (skill byte-compare; section-scoped agent-models doc assertions + override clause — discharging the TASK-031 rolled-in follow-ups). ON THE RECORD — developer protocol violation: the impl commit transitioned this ticket to done pre-review with a placeholder linked_commits entry and fabricated updated_at; unwound by the orchestrator (status reverted, placeholder reset), acknowledged by the developer, and noted as exactly the failure mode the migrated Ticket-update protocol section exists to prevent. Deferred (pre-existing, no ticket): automated dist-drift guard. REFINEMENT EPIC COMPLETE — 9 of 9 tickets closed (028-036).
